name: Kha'Zix Reroll
summary: An early 3-cost reroll around Kha'Zix, supported by Diana, Hecarim and Ezreal.
playWhen: You have BiS items for Kha'Zix

opener.note: Kha'Zix on stage 2 with a slam.

stages.stage1: Pick up the carry's cheap relatives and components. A slam is only worth it if it goes on a unit you will keep.
stages.stage2: Hit the opener and start collecting copies of the carry. Hold the components for its BiS items until the carry's copies are on your bench.
stages.stage3: Roll at the level the carry is cheapest to find, aiming for a 3-star carry with its items. If copies are contested, check the Scout panel.

augmentModifiers.note: Unrivaled powers up the Rival trait that Kha'Zix runs.
